According to entry 419, category 1 material and Category 2 material as defined in Articles 4 and 5 respectively of Regulation (EC) No 1774/2002, and ingredients derived therefrom are prohibited in cosmetics products. Regulation (EC) No 1774/2002 has been repealed and replaced by Regulation No. 1069/2009. For Category 1 and 2 materials in Regulation No. 1069/2009, please see Article 8 and 9, respectively.

99248.d: (Broccoli/Cabbage/Eruca Sativa/Radish) Sprout/Moringa Oleifera Leaf Extract is the extract of the sprouts of Brassica oleracea italica, Brassica oleracea capitata, Eruca sativa and Raphanus sativa; and the leaves of Moringa oleifera.

97166.d: (Broccoli/Eruca Sativa/Lepidium Sativum/Nasturtium Officinale/Radish) Sprout Extract is the extract of the sprouts of Brassica oleracea italica, Eruca sativa , Lepidium sativum , Nasturtium officinale and Raphanus sativus.

94110.n: (CALENDULA OFFICINALIS/SAFFLOWER FLOWER)/(ACHILLEA MILLEFOLIUM FLOWER/LEAF/STEM)/(VACCINIUM MYRTILLUS/VITEX AGNUS-CASTUS FRUIT)/RHUS CHINENSIS GALL/WALNUT HUSK/(CAMELLIA SINENSIS/NETTLE LEAF)/(JUNIPERUS COMMUNIS LEAF/STEM)/HORSE CHESTNUT NUT/DICHROA FEBRIFUGA ROOT/GRAPE SEED/ACACIA CATECHU WOOD/GOLDENROD/HYPERICUM PERFORATUM EXTRACT
94110.d: This is the extract of the flowers of  Calendula officinalis  , and  Carthamus tinctorius  (safflower); the flower, leaves and stems of  Achillea millefolium  ; the fruits of  Vaccinium myrtillus  , and  Vitex agnus-castus  ; the gall of  Rhus chinensis  ; the husks of  Juglans regia  (walnut); the leaves of  Camellia sinensis  , and  Urtica dioica  (nettle); the leaves and stems of  Juniperus communis  ; the nuts of  Aesculus hippocastanum  (horse chestnut); the roots of  Dichroa febrifuga  ; the seeds of  Vitis vinifera  (grape); the whole plants,  Hypericum perforatum  , and  Solidago virgaurea  (goldenrod).

94144.n: (CAMELLIA JAPONICA/PRUNUS MUME/SAFFLOWER FLOWER)/(ARONIA ARBUTIFOLIA/BLUEBERRY/CRANBERRY/EUTERPE OLERACEA FRUIT)/CAMELLIA SINENSIS LEAF/GARCINIA MANGOSTANA PEEL/COFFEE SEED/PROPOLIS/WINE EXTRACT
94144.d: This is the extract of the flowers of  Camellia japonica  ,  Carthamus tinctorius  (safflower), and  Prunus mume  ; the fruits of  Aronia arbutifolia  ,  Euterpe oleracea  ,  Vaccinium angustifolium  (blueberry), and  Vaccinium macrocarpon  (cranberry); the leaves of  Camellia sinensis ; the peel of  Garcinia mangostana  ; the seeds of  Coffea arabica  (coffee); propolis, and wine.

104004.n: (CAMELLIA SINENSIS LEAF/COIX LACRYMA-JOBI MA-YUEN SEED/MORUS ALBA BARK/PANAX GINSENG ROOT/SALVIA OFFICINALIS) EXTRACT
104004.d: (Camellia Sinensis Leaf/Coix Lacryma-Jobi Ma-yuen Seed/Morus Alba Bark/Panax Ginseng Root/Salvia Officinalis) Extract is the extract of Camellia Sinensis Leaf, Coix Lacryma-Jobi Ma-yuen Seed, the bark of Morus alba, Panax Ginseng Root and the whole plant, Salvia officinalis.

101817.n: (CAMPHOR/CEDRUS LIBANI/SALVADORA PERSICA BARK)/(GARLIC/ONION BULB)/(DATE/GOURD/GRAPE/LENTIL/OLIVE/PUNICA GRANATUM FRUIT)/(FIG FRUIT/LEAF)/ACACIA SEYAL GUM/(BASIL/ZIZIPHUS SPINA-CHRISTI LEAF)/GINGER ROOT/PUNICA GRANATUM PERICARP/BRASSICA NIGRA SEED/(ONION SKIN)/CUCUMBER EXTRACT
101817.d: This is the extract of the bark of Cinnamomum camphora (camphor), Cedrus libani, and Salvadora persica; the bulbs of Allium sativum (garlic); the bulbs and skin of Allium cepa (onion); the fruits of Phoenix dactylifera (date), Cucurbitaceae, Vitis vinifera (grape), Lens culinaris (lentil), and Olea europaea (olive); the fruit and leaves of Ficus carica (fig); Acacia Seyal Gum (q.v.), the leaves of Ocimum basilicum (basil) and Ziziphus spina-christi; the pericarp of Punica granatum; the roots of Zingiber officinale (ginger); the seeds of Brassica nigra, and the whole plant, Cucumis sativus (cucumber).

94450.n: (CANANGA ODORATA FLOWER/LEAF)/GANODERMA LUCIDUM FRUITING BODY/(CORCHORUS OLITORIUS/HENNA/MELIA AZADIRACHTA/MORUS ALBA/MUNTINGIA CALABURA/PSIDIUM GUAJAVA/TAMARINDUS INDICA LEAF)/(CITRUS HYSTRIX LEAF/PEEL)/(CITRONELLA/CYMBOPOGON SCHOENANTHUS/OCIMUM TENUIFLORUM LEAF/STEM)/(ALPINIA GALANGA/BOESENBERGIA ROTUNDA/GINGER/TURMERIC RHIZOME)/ZINGIBER CASSUMUNAR ROOT EXTRACT
94450.d: This is the extract of the product obtained by the fermentation of the flowers and leaves of  Cananga odorata  ; the fruiting bodies of  Ganoderma lucidum  ; the leaves of  Corchorus olitorius  ,  Lawsonia inermis  (henna),  Melia azadirachta  ,  Morus alba  ,  Muntingia calabura  ,  Psidium guajava  , and  Tamarindus indica  ; the leaves and peels of  Citrus hystrix  ; the leaves and stems of  Cymbopogon nardus  (citronella),  Cymbopogon schoenanthus  , and  Ocimum tenuiflorum  ; the rhizomes of  Alpinia galanga  ,  Boesenbergia rotunda  ,  Curcuma longa  (turmeric), and  Zingiber officinale  (ginger); and the roots of  Zingiber cassumunar.

89269.n: (CARTHAMUS TINCTORIUS/CHAMOMILLA RECUTITA/SYZYGIUM AROMATICUM) FLOWER/(LITHOSPERMUM ERYTHRORHIZON/SOPHORA FLAVESCENS/SCUTELLARIA BAICALENSIS) ROOT EXTRACT
89269.d: (Carthamus Tinctorius/Chamomilla Recutita/Syzygium Aromaticum) Flower/(Lithospermum Erythrorhizon/Sophora Flavescens/Scutellaria Baicalensis) Root Extract is the extract of the flowers of Carthamus tinctorius, Chamomilla recutita, Syzygium aromaticum and the roots of Lithospermum erythrorhizon, Sophora flavescens , and Scutellaria baicalensis

100647.n: (CHAENOMELES SPECIOSA FRUIT/LEAF/ROOT/TWIG)/CROCUS SATIVUS FLOWER/CUSCUTA CHINENSIS SEED/LILIUM BROWNII BULB/LONICERA JAPONICA BUD/(MORUS ALBA FRUIT/LEAF/ROOT/TWIG)/(GASTRODIA ELATA/PLATYCLADUS ORIENTALIS/REHMANNIA GLUTINOSA TUBER)/SCUTELLARIA BARBATA/SESAMUM INDICUM SEED/VITIS VINIFERA FRUIT EXTRACT
100647.d: This is the extract of the fruit, leaves, roots and twigs of Chaenomeles speciosa and Morus alba; the flowers of Crocus sativus; the seeds of Cuscuta chinensis, Scutellaria barbata and Sesamum indicum; the bulbs of Lilium brownii; the buds of Lonicera japonica; the tubers of Gastrodia elata, Platycladus orientalis and Rehmannia glutinosa; the whole plant, Scutellaria barbata and the fruit of Vitis vinifera.

99525.n: (CINNAMOMUM CASSIA/MAGNOLIA OFFICINALIS) BARK/(ALPINIA OFFICINARUM/ANGELICA GIGAS) ROOT EXTRACT
99525.d: (Cinnamomum Cassia/Magnolia Officinalis) Bark/(Alpinia Officinarum/Angelica Gigas) Root Extract is the extract of the bark of Cinnamomum cassia and Magnolia officinalis , and of the roots of Alpinia officinarum and Angelica gigas.

104062.n: (CITRUS AURANTIUM AMARA/FORSYTHIA SUSPENSA) FRUIT/SCUTELLARIA BAICALENSIS ROOT EXTRACT
104062.d: Citrus Aurantium Amara/Forsythia Suspensa) Fruit/Scutellaria Baicalensis Root Extract is the extract of the fruits of Citrus aurantium amara and Forsythia suspensa and the roots of Scutellaria baicalensis.

105521.n: (CITRUS RETICULATA FRUIT JUICE/MALUS DOMESTICA FRUIT JUICE/CARICA PAPAYA FRUIT JUICE) VESICLES
105521.d: (Citrus Reticulata Fruit Juice/Malus Domestica Fruit Juice/Carica Papaya Fruit Juice) Vesicles are the vesicles isolated from a mix of Citrus Reticulata Fruit Juice, Malus Domestica Fruit Juice, and Carica Papaya Fruit Juice.

97164.d: (Cnidium Officinale/Coptis Chinensis/Glycyrrhiza Uralensis) Root Extract is the extract of the roots of Cnidium officinale , Coptis chinensis and Glycyrrhiza uralensis

90383.n: (CODONOPSIS TANGSHEN/DIOSCOREA JAPONICA) ROOT/ATRACTYLODES JAPONICA RHIZOME/PORIA COCOS/(DOLICHOS LABLAB/COIX LACRYMA-JOBI MA-YUEN/EURYALE FEROX/NELUMBO NUCIFERA) SEED EXTRACT
90383.d: (Codonopsis Tangshen/Dioscorea Japonica) Root/Atractyloides Japonica Rhizome/Poria Cocos/(Dolichos Lablab/Coix Lacryma-Jobi Ma-yuen/Euryale Ferox/Nelumbo Nucifera) Seed Extract is the extract of the roots of Codonopsis tangshen and Dioscorea japonica ; the rhizomes of Atractyloides japonica ; the whole plant, Poria cocos ; and the seeds of Dolichos lablab, Coix Lacryma-Jobi Ma-yuen, Euryale Ferox and Nelumbo nucifera.

106210.d: (Copper Tripeptide-1/Oligopeptide-295/Zinc Oligopeptide-296) Peptides are the random peptides created during solid-phase synthesis of Copper Tripeptide-1, Oligopeptide-295, and Zinc Oligopeptide-296.

99553.n: (CORNUS OFFICINALIS/LYCIUM CHINENSE/MORUS BOMBYCIS/RICE/SCHISANDRA CHINENSIS/ZIZYPHUS JUJUBA) FRUIT/(CAMELLIA SINENSIS/DIOSPYROS KAKI/GINKGO BILOBA/PERILLA FRUTESCENS) LEAF/CITRUS UNSHIU PEEL/(CODONOPSIS LANCEOLATA/CYNANCHUM WILFORDII/PANAX GINSENG/PLATYCODON GRANDIFLORUM/PLEUROPTERUS MULTIFLORUS/POLYGONATUM ODORATUM) ROOT/GLYCINE MAX SEED/(ELEUTHEROCOCCUS SENTICOSUS/LICORICE) STEM/(ARTEMISIA ANNUA/HOUTTUYNIA CORDATA) STEM/LEAF/CIRSIUM JAPONICUM/DANDELION/LAMINARIA DIGITATA/TARAXACUM PLATYCARPUM WATER
99553.d: This is an aqueous solution of the steam distillates obtained from the fruits of Cornus officinalis , Lycium chinense , Morus bombycis , Oryza sativa , Schisandra chinensis , and Zizyphus jujuba; the leaves of Camellia sinensis, Diospyros kaki, Ginkgo biloba , and Perilla frutescens ; the peel of Citrus unshiu; the roots of Codonopsis lanceolata, Cynanchum wilfordii, Panax ginseng , Platycodon grandiflorum, Pleuropterus multiflorus , and Polygonatum odoratum; the seeds of Glycine max; the stems of Eleutherococcus senticosus , and Glycyrrhiza uralensis; the stems and leaves of Artemisia annua , and Houttuynia cordata; the whole plants, Cirsium japonicum, Laminaria digitata, Taraxacum officinale and Taraxacum platycarpum. 98157.d: (Cryptomeria Japonica/Chamaecyparis Obtusa) Stem Ferment Extract is the extract of the product obtained by the spontaneous fermentation of the stems of Cryptomeria japonica and Chamaecyparis obtusa.

106715.n: (CURCUMA LONGA CALLUS CULTURE CONDITIONED MEDIA/OLEA EUROPAEA CALLUS CULTURE) LYSATE
106715.d: (Curcuma Longa Callus Culture Conditioned Media/Olea Europaea Callus Culture) Lysate is a lysate of a suspension of the growth media removed from cultures of the callus of Curcuma longa (turmeric) after several days of growth and a suspension of the cultured callus cells of Olea europaea.

99616.d: (Curcuma Longa/Glycyrrhiza Uralensis) Root Extract is the extract of the roots of Curcuma longa and Glycyrrhiza uralensis.

100637.d: (Cymbopogon Citratus Leaf/Stem)/(Vetiveria Zizanioides Leaf/Root) Water is the aqueous solution of the steam distillates obtained from the leaves and stems of Cymbopogon citratus and the leaves and roots of Vetiveria zizanoides.

103620.n: (DELPHINIUM CONSOLIDA/LONICERA CAPRIFOLIUM/CALENDULA OFFICINALIS/CENTAUREA CYANUS) FLOWER EXTRACT
103620.d: (Delphinium Consolida/Lonicera Caprifolium/Calendula Officinalis/Centaurea Cyanus) Flower Extract is the extract of the flowers of Delphinium consolida, Lonicera caprifolium, Calendula officinalis, and Centaurea cyanus. The accepted scientific name for Delphinium consolida is Consolida regalis.

97165.d: (Eclipta Prostrata/Houttuynia Cordata) Leaf Extract is the extract of the leaves of Eclipta prostrata and Houttuynia cordata.

100865.d: (Eriobotrya Japonica/Myrica Rubra) Seed Extract is the extract of the seeds of Eriobotrya japonica and Myrica rubra.

106773.n: (ETHYL TRIMETHYLBENZOYL PHENYLPHOSPHINATE) AMIDO/FERULYL ADIPIC DIHYDRAZIDO HYALURONAMIDE
106773.d: (Ethyl Trimethylbenzoyl Phenylphosphinate) Amido/Ferulyl Adipic Dihydrazido Hyaluronamide is a derivative of Hyaluronic Acid where some of the carboxylic acid groups along the polysaccharide have been reacted to form amide bonds with two different substituents.

106673.d: (Eurya Japonica/Mallotus Japonicus) Leaf/Stem Extract is the extract of the leaves and stems of Eurya japonica and Mallotus japonicus.

99271.d: (Euterpe Oleracea/Euterpe Precatoria) Fruit Extract is the extract of the fruit of Euterpe oleracea and Euterpe precatoria.

99272.d: (Euterpe Oleracea/Euterpe Precatoria/Theobroma Grandiflorum) Fruit Extract is the extract of the fruits of Euterpe oleracea, Euterpe precatoria and Theobroma grandiflorum.

93903.d: (Gelidium Elegans/Lingulatum/Rex/Sesquipedale)/(Gracilaria Chilensis/Vermiculophylla)/Pterocladiella Tenuis Oligosaccharides are the oligosaccharides produced by the enzymatic degradation of Agar that is obtained from  Gelidium elegans, Pterocladiella tenuis, Gelidium sesquipedale, Gelidium rex, Gelidium lingulatum, Gracilaria vermiculophylla, Gracilaria chilensis  and  Hydropuntia eucheumatoides.

101095.n: (GERANIUM NEPALENSE /PICRASMA QUASSIOIDES /QUERCUS MONGOLICA /TILIA AMURENSIS) LEAF/STEM EXTRACT
101095.d: (Geranium Nepalense /Picrasma Quassioides /Quercus Mongolica /Tilia Amurensis) Leaf/Stem Extract is the extract of the leaves and stems of Geranium nepalense, Picrasma quassioides, Quercus mongolica and Tilia amurensis.

99153.d: (Glycyrrhiza Uralensis (Licorice)/Hedychium Spicatum/Scutellaria Baicalensis) Root Extract is the extract of the roots of Glycyrrhiza uralensis, Hedychium spicatum and Scutellaria baicalensis.

101637.n: (GOSSYPIUM HERBACEUM (COTTON) CALLUS CULTURE/PUNICA GRANATUM CALLUS CULTURE) LYSATE
101637.d: (Gossypium Herbaceum (Cotton) Callus Culture/Punica Granatum Callus Culture) Lysate is a lysate of a suspension of the cultured callus cells of Gossypium herbaceum and Punica granatum.

92134.n: (GRIFOLA FRONDOSA/INONOTUS OBLIQUUS /SCHIZOPHYLLUM COMMUNE/ TRICHOLOMA MATSUTAKE) MYCELIUM /LETHARIELLA CLADONIOIDES FERMENT EXTRACT FILTRATE

97168.d: (Honey + Zymomonas Ferment) Extract is the extract of a mixture of honey with the product obtained through the fermentation of Zymomonas.

101325.d: (Horse Heart/Trehalose/Oryza Sativa Bran/Sodium Silicate) Extract is the extract of the mixture containing the ground powder derived from the horse heart, Trehalose, Oryza Sativa Bran and Sodium Silicate.

99645.d: (Hylocereus Undatus/Actinidia Chinensis) Peel Extract is the extract obtained from the peels of Actinidia chinensis and Hylocereus undatus.

104157.n: (LACTOBACILLUS/MILLET SEED FLOUR FERMENT & PANICUM MILIACEUM SEED EXTRACT) FILTRATE
104157.d: (Lactobacillus/Millet Seed Flour Ferment & Panicum Miliaceum Seed Extract) Filtrate is a filtrate of the product obtained by the fermentation of a mixture of Panicum Miliaceum Seed Extract and Panicum Miliaceum Seed Flour, by the microorganism, Lactobacillus.

96819.d: (Lactobacillus/Polysorbate 80 Ferment + Leuconostoc/Polysorbate 80 Ferment) Lysate Filtrate is the filtrate of a lysate of the mixture of the products obtained through the fermentation of Lactobacillus with Polysorbate 80, and through the fermentation of Leuconostoc with polysorbate 80.

93671.n: (LAVANDULA ANGUSTIFOLIA/MELISSA OFFICINALIS/HYPERICUM PERFORATUM) FLOWER/(CAMELLIA SINENSIS LEAF/(GLYCYRRHIZA GLABRA/ACANTHOPANAX SENTICOSUS) ROOT/SARRACENIA COBRA NEST LEAF/FLOWER/STALK EXTRACT
93671.d:
(Lavandula Angustifolia/Melissa Officinalis/Hypericum Perforatum) Flower/(Camellia Sinensis Leaf/(Glycyrrhiza Glabra/Acanthopanax Senticosus) Root/Sarracenia Cobra Nest Leaf/Flower/Stalk Extract. 

This is the extract of the flowers of  Lavandula angustifolia, Melissa officinalis, Hypericum perforatum  , the leaves of  Camellia sinensis  , the roots of  Glycyrrhiza glabra, Acanthopanax senticosus  , and the leaves, flowers and stalk of  Sarracenia  'Cobra Nest'

97163.n: (LESPEDEZA BICOLOR/PHELLODENDRON AMURENSE BARK)/MENTHA ARVENSIS LEAF/(ANEMARRHENA ASPHODELOIDES/SCUTELLARIA BAICALENSIS ROOT) EXTRACT
97163.d: This is the extract of the bark of Lespedeza bicolor and Phellodendron amurense ; the leaves of Mentha arvensis ; the roots of Anemarrhena asphodeloides and Scutellaria baicalensis.

96674.d: (Licorice/Reynoutria Japonica) Root/Stem Extract is the extract of the roots and stems of Glycyrrhiza uralensis and Reynoutria japonica.

90728.n: (LINDERA STRYCHNIFOLIA/PAEONIA ALBIFLORA) ROOT/COMMIPHORA MYRRHA RESIN/SWERTIA JAPONICA/UNCARIA GAMBIR EXTRACT
90728.d: (Lindera Strychnifolia/Paeonia Albiflora) Root/Commiphora Myrrha Resin/Swertia Japonica/Uncaria Gambir Extract is the extract of the roots of Lindera strychnifolia and Paeonia albiflora , Commiphora Myrrha Resin and the whole plants, Swertia japonica and Uncaria gambir.

94895.n: (LIQUIDAMBAR FORMOSANA/TRIBULUS TERRESTRIS) FRUIT/PAEONIA LACTIFLORA ROOT EXTRACT
94895.d: (Liquidambar Formosana/Tribulus Terrestris) Fruit/Paeonia Lactiflora Root Extract is the extract of the fruit of  Liquidambar formosana  and  Tribulus terrestris, and the roots of Paeonia lactiflora.

94896.n: (LIQUIDAMBAR STYRACIFLUA/TRIBULUS TERRESTRIS) FRUIT/PAEONIA LACTIFLORA ROOT EXTRACT
94896.d: (Liquidambar Styraciflua/Tribulus Terrestris) Fruit/Paeonia Lactiflora Root Extract is the extract of the fruit of  Liquidambar styraciflua  and  Tribulus terrestris  , and the roots of  Paeonia lactiflora.

101803.n: (LONICERA JAPONICA/ROSA RUGOSA FLOWER/LEAF)/ARTEMISIA PRINCEPS LEAF/STEM EXTRACT
101803.d: (Lonicera Japonica/Rosa Rugosa Flower/Leaf)/Artemisia Princeps Leaf/Stem Extract is the extract of the leaves and flowers of Lonicera japonica and Rosa rugosa, and the leaves and stems of Artemisia princeps.

99518.n: (MAGNOLIA OFFICINALIS/PHELLODENDRON AMURENSE) BARK/CAMELLIA JAPONICA LEAF/ZINGIBER OFFICINALE ROOT/CITRUS PARADISI SEED WATER
99518.d: (Magnolia Officinalis/Phellodendron Amurense) Bark/Camellia Japonica Leaf/Zingiber Officinale Root/Citrus Paradisi Seed Water is the aqueous solution obtained from the steam distillates of the bark of Magnolia officinalis and Phellodendron amurense , the roots of Zingiber officinale and the seeds of Citrus paradisi. The accepted scientific name for Citrus paradisi is Citrus x aurantium.

100140.n: (MORUS ALBA FRUIT/SUCROSE FERMENT FILTRATE) POLYGONUM MULTIFLORUM ROOT EXTRACT FERMENT FILTRATE
100140.d: (Morus Alba Fruit/Sucrose Ferment Filtrate) Polygonum Multiflorum Root Extract Ferment Filtrate is a filtrate of the product obtained by the spontaneous fermentation of the fruit of Morus alba and sucrose, which subsequently undergoes spontaneous fermentation with Polygonum Multiflorum Root Extract, followed by filtration.

95360.n: (PAEONIA LACTIFLORA BARK/SAP)/PHELLODENDRON AMURENSE BARK/MENTHA ARVENSIS LEAF/SCUTELLARIA BAICALENSIS ROOT EXTRACT
95360.d: This is the extract of the bark of  Paeonia lactiflora  , and  Phellodendron amurense  ; the sap of  Paeonia lactiflora  ; the leaves of  Mentha arvensis  ; and the roots of  Scutellaria baicalensis.

100120.n: (PAEONIA LACTIFLORA BARK/SAP)/PHELLODENDRON AMURENSE BARK/SCUTELLARIA BAICALENSIS ROOT/MENTHA ARVENSIS EXTRACT
100120.d:
(Paeonia Lactiflora Bark/Sap)/Phellodendron Amurense Bark/Scutellaria Baicalensis Root/Mentha Arvensis Extract
Definition: This is the extract of the bark of Paeonia lactiflora , and Phellodendron amurense ; the sap of Paeonia lactiflora ; the roots of Scutellaria baicalensis and the whole plant Mentha arvensis.

97167.n: (PANAX GINSENG MERISTEM CELL + TAXUS CUSPIDATA MERISTEM CELL CULTURE CONDITIONED MEDIA + PANAX GINSENG LEAF/ROOT/STEM POWDER) EXTRACT
97167.d: (Panax Ginseng Meristem Cell + Taxus Cuspidata Meristem Cell Culture Conditioned Media + Panax Ginseng Leaf/Root/Stem Powder) Extract is the extract of the mixture of Panax Ginseng Meristem Cell, Taxus Cuspidata Meristem Cell Culture Conditioned Media dried, and the dried, ground leaves, roots and stems of Panax ginseng.

100705.n: (PEANUT FRUIT/SPROUT)/(LICORICE/SCUTELLARIA BAICALENSIS/SOPHORA FLAVESCENS ROOT)/CENTELLA ASIATICA EXTRACT
100705.d: (Peanut Fruit/Sprout)/(Licorice/Scutellaria Baicalensis/Sophora Flavescens Root)/Centella Asiatica Extract is the extract of the fruit and sprouts of Arachis hypogaea (peanut); the roots of Glycyrrhiza glabra (licorice), Scutellaria baicalensis and Sophora flavescens; and the whole plant, Centella asiatica.

104551.d: (Phyllanthus Emblica/Serenoa Serrulata) Fruit/Rosa Multiflora) Extract is the extract of the fruit of Phyllanthus emblica and Serenoa serrulata and the whole plant of Rosa multiflora. The accepted scientific name for Serenoa serrulata is Serenoa repens.

101797.n: (PINUS SYLVESTRIS CONE/LEMON FRUIT/HOPS/ROSEMARY LEAF/EQUISETUM ARVENSE) EXTRACT

100967.d: This is the extract of the product obtained by the spontaneous fermentation of the bark of Betula platyphylla; the buds of Brassica oleracea botrytis (cauliflower), and Brassica oleracea italica (broccoli); the bulbs of Allium cepa (onion), and Allium sativum (garlic); the flowers of Chrysanthemum morifolium, Hemerocallis fulva, Rosa rugosa, and Zingiber mioga; the fruits of Abelmoschus esculentus, Capsicum annuum, Carica papaya (papaya), Citrullus lanatus (watermelon), Citrus junos, Citrus unshiu, Cucumis melo (melon), Cucumis sativus (cucumber), Cucurbita pepo (pumpkin), Diospyros kaki, Ficus carica (fig), Lonicera caerulea, Prunus mume, Prunus persica (peach), Prunus salicina (plum), Pyrus communis (pear), Pyrus malus (apple), Rubus idaeus (raspberry), Solanum lycopersicum (tomato), Solanum melongena (eggplant), and Vitis vinifera (grape); the fruiting bodies of Flammulina velutipes, Grifola frondosa and Lentinus edodes; the hypocotyls of Glycine soja (soybean); the leaves of Acer palmatum, Angelica keiskei, Artemisia princeps, Brassica oleracea capitata (cabbage), Brassica rapa (turnip), Camellia japonica, Camellia sinensis, Equisetum arvense, Eriobotrya japonica, Lactuca sativa, Lippia citriodora, Ocimum basilicum (basil), Perilla frutescens, Rosmarinus officinalis (rosemary), Salvia officinalis (sage), Sasa veitchii, Taraxacum officinale (dandelion), and Thymus vulgaris (thyme); the leaves and stems of Allium fistulosum, Allium tuberosum, Apium graveolens (celery), Brassica rapa chinensis (bok choy), Brassica rapa pekinensis (napa cabbage), Brassica rapa perviridis (komatsuma), Carum petroselinum (parsley), Chrysanthemum coronarium, Cryptotaenia japonica, Glechoma hederacea, Mentha piperita (peppermint), Nasturtium officinale, Portulaca oleracea, and Spinacia oleracea (spinach); the rhizomes of Nelumbo nucifera; the roots of Arctium lappa, Cichorium intybus (chicory), Curcuma longa (turmeric), Daucus carota (carrot), Ipomoea batatas, Raphanus sativus (radish), Wasabia japonica, and Zingiber officinale (ginger); the seeds of Ginkgo biloba, Helianthus annuus (sunflower), and Sesamum indicum (sesame); the stems of Asparagus officinalis, and Solanum tuberosum (potato); the whole plant of Eichhornia crassipes, and Melissa officinalis, and the alga, Saccharina angustata .

This is the extract of the bark of Boswellia sacra; the flowers of Crocus sativus; the fruit of Capparis spinosa, Citrullus colocynthis, Citrullus vulgaris (watermelon), Citrus junos, Crataegus oxycantha, Cydonia oblonga, Solanum melongena (eggplant), and Ziziphus jujuba; the leaves of Artemisia annua, Anethum graveolens (dill), Cassia angustiflolia, Cichorium intybus (chicory), Eruca sativa, and Thymus vulgaris (thyme); the leaves and stems of Euphorbia supina; the resin of Commiphora myrrha; the roots of Acorus calamus, Allium fistulosum, Beta vulgaris (beet), Cichorium intybus (chicory), Saussurea lappa; the seeds of Hordeum vulgare, Nigella sativa, Trigonella foenum-graecum, Triticum aestivum (wheat); the fungi: Agaricus bisporus, Auricularia auricula-judae, Ganoderma lucidum, Grifola frondosa, Inonotus obliquus, Lentinus edodes, Phellinus linteus, Sparassis crispa, Tremella fuciformis; the seeds and skin of Sorghum vulgare, the sprouts of Lepidum sativum, and the whole plants of Apium graveolens (celery), Artemesia maritima, Indigofera tinctoria, Narcissus tazetta, Origanum vulgare, and Portulaca oleracea.

97614.d: Dimethylhydrogensiloxy Phenyl Polysilsesquioxane is made by hydrolysis and condensation of a mixture of phenyl trimethoxysilane and dimethychlorosilane. Polysilsesquioxanes are resinous materials composed of a mixture of three-dimensional siloxane polymers and/or oligomers with cage structures. For the oligomers, each silicon atom in the polysilsesquioxane is connected via oxygen atoms to three other silicon atoms and can be represented by the empirical formulation RSiO3/2, where R represents a phenyl group. For the larger polymeric polysilsesquioxanes, some of the silicon atoms are not connected to other silicon atoms and instead have a silanol (SiOH) group. For this material, the dimethylchlorosilane (HSiMe2Cl) acts as an end-blocking group and produces a polysilsesquioxane that contains dimethylhydrogen siloxy (HMe2SiO-) groups.

The last two reactions are done in the presence of acetic acid so that the positive charges on the finished polymer are balanced by acetate ions.
